title: Micro Dose
description:
Remember that drug game on your graphing calculator? ... that.

A fictional calculator-era underworld economy. Read the night’s forecast, set price, quantity, quality and distribution, then run the night and see what happened. 

Climb six career levels from Runner to Empire. Earn profits, buy districts and fronts, and unlock new distribution routes. Career shows your next unfinished goal. Lay low reduces heat while your fronts still bring in income.

Build the Empire by earning $60,000 net, owning all six districts and three fronts, and keeping heat below 60. You can keep playing afterward. Negative cash or heat at 100 ends the campaign. Up and Down browse; Select edits or acts. Progress saves automatically.

For Pebble Time 2 and Round 2. Touch requires firmware 4.33.2; button controls remain available. By Luke Steuber.
releaseNotes: Touch controls follow the visible rows and buttons. Back saves changes before leaving the plan editor.
